content.title: Show loading progress and resolve consistently for slow_user
content.intent: Prove that slow_user sees understandable loading or progress feedback and eventually reaches a consistent authenticated banking experience.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the documented slow_user persona because it represents intentionally slow-loading behavior; applied state/flow because the scenario must traverse a loading state into the resolved dashboard; applied negative/error reasoning to ensure the surface does not appear permanently broken. Risk gate implied strength=3 because the resolved state contains money-facing information, but no combinatorial input matrix was needed because the persona class alone defines this path.
